FIELDS.NAME: Model Masters Hobby Shop
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: At Model Masters Hobby Shop, we specialize in providing a wide range of hobby and model-building supplies, including plastic model kits, radio-controlled vehicles, and crafting materials. Our operations focus on retail, with an emphasis on customer service and community engagement. We maintain a clean and organized store environment, ensuring safe navigation with clear aisles and appropriate lighting. Our knowledgeable staff is trained to assist customers with expert guidance on product selection and usage. We also offer instructional workshops, covered by professional liability insurance, to enhance our customers' skills and knowledge. To ensure compliance with local safety codes and regulations, we conduct regular inspections and maintain all required safety equipment, including fire extinguishers and first aid kits. We are committed to providing a safe shopping experience and to maintaining a strong inventory management system to ensure product availability for our valued customers.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Losses occurred due to water damage from a broken pipe on 03/15/2023, resulting in $2,500 in repairs. The issue has been resolved, and all necessary measures have been taken to prevent future incidents.
FIELDS.Combined Single Limit: $1,000,000 Combined Single Limit with a $1,000 deductible
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Saturday: 10:00 AM - 7:00 PM; Sunday: 12:00 PM - 5:00 PM
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Combination safe, Class B, UL listed.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Installed fencing around the exterior premises and engaged on-site watchpersons during store hours to enhance security and safety measures.
FIELDS.G1: Do/have past, present or discontinue: No – Model Masters Hobby Shop does not involve storing, treating, discharging, applying, disposing, or transporting hazardous materials in its operations. The business focuses on retail sales of hobby and model-building supplies within safe and compliant practices.
FIELDS.G2: Are athletic teams sponsored?: No – Model Masters Hobby Shop does not sponsor any athletic teams as part of its business activities. Our focus is primarily on retail sales of hobby and model-building supplies.
FIELDS.G3: Are sub-contractors allowed to work: No – Sub-contractors are not allowed to work without providing a certificate of insurance. The certificates are checked by the management team to ensure compliance and proper risk management.
FIELDS.G4: Has any applicant been indicted or c: No – The applicant has not been indicted or convicted of any crime related to fraud, bribery, arson, or any other arson-related crime in connection with this or any other property.
FIELDS.G5: Any policy or coverage declined, can: No – Model Masters Hobby Shop has not had any policies or coverages declined, canceled, or non-renewed during the prior 3 years. We maintain a good standing with our previous insurance carrier and have resolved all previous claims appropriately.
FIELDS.G6: Do you lease employees to or from ot: No – Model Masters Hobby Shop does not lease employees to or from other employers. All staff are directly employed by the business to ensure consistency in service and training.
FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: Yes – Model Masters Hobby Shop carries workers' compensation insurance to comply with legal requirements and ensure the safety of all employees.
FIELDS.G8: Do you own or operate any other busi: Yes – Model Masters Hobby Shop also operates another business called Model Masters Crafts and Supplies, which complements our retail offerings in hobby and crafting materials.
FIELDS.G9: Any other insurance with this compan: No – Model Masters Hobby Shop does not have any other insurance with this company at this time. Currently, the business holds only one policy under the provided details.
FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – Model Masters Hobby Shop is not involved in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products. Our operations focus solely on retail sales of hobby and model-building supplies.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – Model Masters Hobby Shop does not rent or loan equipment to others, as our focus is solely on retailing hobby and model-building supplies. This helps maintain a controlled and safe environment for our customers.
FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – The applicant has not had any foreclosure, repossession, bankruptcy, judgment, or lien during the past five years.
FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: No – Model Masters Hobby Shop does not have exposure to flammables, explosives, or chemicals as our operations focus solely on retailing hobby and model-building supplies in a safe and compliant manner. We prioritize maintaining a safe environment for our customers.
FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – Model Masters Hobby Shop does not have any catastrophe exposure, as our operations are focused on retail sales of hobby and model-building supplies without significant risks associated with large-scale disasters. We maintain safety protocols and compliance with all relevant regulations to minimize any potential risks.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – Model Masters Hobby Shop has not had any past losses or claims relating to sexual abuse or molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring. We prioritize a safe and respectful environment for all employees and customers.
FIELDS.G16: Any uncorrected fire code violation: No – Model Masters Hobby Shop has no uncorrected fire code violations and maintains regular inspections to ensure compliance with all local fire and safety codes.
